## Notes from earlier work
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0004] Exclude bool when validating integer inputs: When validating integer parameters, check `isinstance(x, bool)` first because `bool` is a subclass of `int`; reject it explicitly alongside non-int and out-of-range values.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 2 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0008] Audit amounts must be float, not Decimal: When writing audit entries via ledgerly.audit.record, pass the amount as float(amount); the ledger service's JSON importer rejects Decimal values.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary amounts with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Convert amounts with to_money before arithmetic: Wrap raw unit prices with ledgerly.money.to_money before multiplying by quantity, and seed sums with ZERO from ledgerly.money, as line_total and invoice_total do.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0009] Coerce floats via Decimal(str(x)) before to_money: `ledgerly.money.to_money` rejects floats; when a public function may receive a float, convert it with `Decimal(str(value))` first so 0.1 stays 0.1, then pass through `to_money`.
  (learned from task E05 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0007] Refunds above 500.00 need approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per finance policy FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise BillingError("approval_required") when the amount exceeds the threshold and approved_by is missing.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
